summary: Convenience Noether R121 P02-P05 web-session drop bundling the already staged P02, P03, P04, and P05 no-duplicate/source-evidence packages for drag-and-drop use by web sessions.
limitations: This is a convenience bundle, not a new independent correction layer.
It contains no additional TeX patch beyond its bundled packages.
Do not cite it as P02-P05 certification or a critical edition.
Use the individual package manifests for paper-level scope and caveats.
recommended_next_action: Use for web-session handoff convenience only. Public catalog wording should point readers to the individual P02-P05 manifests for actual scope and caveats.
github_note: Corrections and source comparisons can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
